results.description:
Manage all types of vehicles and equipment in one place.
Car, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Airplane, Boat, Tractor, Generator

Complete fleet management for personal or business use

• FOR PERSONAL USE:
Drivvo - Vehicle Management is the free version of the application for personal use. It allows you to have total control over your vehicle costs: refueling, maintenance, oil changes and other services performed in the car, motorcycle, truck or bus.
For personal use and for professionals who use their vehicle for work (Uber, taxi, Cabify, 99, Didi) 

You can now manage vehicles and equipment using an Hour Meter!

• FOR CORPORATE USE:
Drivvo is a system for managing vehicle fleets, which gives the manager total control over vehicles and drivers. Track all refueling, expenses and services, schedule all appointments for each vehicle and driver.

Now you can fully manage your fleet, tracking Refuelings, Expenses, Maintenance (preventive and corrective), Income, Routes, Checklists and Reminders.

• REFUELING
Fuel control is the most important part of managing your vehicle. With the application, you can fill in the refueling data in real time, giving more agility to the management.
The resource allows you to easily identify if there is a problem with the vehicle and if there is a need for maintenance.

• CHARGING FOR ELECTRIC AND HYBRID VEHICLES
Electric and hybrid vehicles are covered too: log charges, track consumption in mi/kWh, and manage energy costs — all in one app.

• CHECKLIST
Create custom forms to run inspections on your vehicles, ensuring your vehicle is roadworthy. This reduces the risk of mechanical problems in remote or unfamiliar locations.
The vehicle checklist helps you identify and fix safety issues before they become dangerous. Items such as brakes, tires, lights and seat belts can be checked regularly to ensure the vehicle is in safe operating condition.

• EXPENSE
Drivvo allows you to have total control over your vehicle's expenses, registering taxes, insurance, fines, parking, among other expenses.

• SERVICE
Oil changes, brake checks, tire changes, filters, air conditioning cleaning. All these services can be easily viewed in the app.

• INCOME
Drivvo also makes it possible to record income, to make life easier for drivers who use their vehicle as a work tool, such as transport app drivers, for example.

• ROUTE
Keep a record of all trips that are made on a day-to-day basis.
If you use your vehicle for work and are paid per kilometer driven, Drivvo helps you organize and calculate your travel reimbursements.
It makes it easier for the fleet manager to identify the driver who was behind the wheel.

• REMINDER
Having scheduled preventive maintenance is another fundamental activity in managing your vehicle.
With the help of the app, you can set reminders to track regular services such as oil changes, tire replacements, inspections and tune-ups — scheduled by mileage or date.

• FLEET MANAGEMENT
Drivvo is a vehicle fleet management system that gives the fleet manager full control over vehicle and driver data.
Try for free:
https://www.drivvo.com/en-US/fleet-management

• DRIVER MANAGEMENT
Have complete control of drivers in each vehicle, manage driver's licenses, get reports by vehicle and period.

• DETAILED REPORTS AND CHARTS
Access the information of each vehicle, separated by date and modules. Visualize the performance of the fleet through graphs, which help in decision making.
